title: ha/dr: automate multi-AZ failover, restore drills, and runbooks-as-code for private installs
author: Sofia Patel
description: Motivation: private (VPC/on-prem) customers require predictable, testable high-availability and disaster recovery (HA/DR) runbooks that can be executed automatically and audited. This PR implements automation for multi-AZ failover and restore drills, updates Helm charts and Terraform modules to support graceful failovers, and introduces runbooks-as-code so DR playbooks are versioned, testable, and runnable from CI. Summary of changes and rationale: 1) Terraform: new module terraform/modules/az-failover that wires health checks, cross-AZ target groups, and optional route53 failover records for customer-managed DNS. The module exposes parameters for az_count, failover_policy, and probe_grace_period so Dedicated/Private operators can tune SLOs. 2) Helm charts: helm/charts/private updated with ha-aware readiness/liveness probes, PodDisruptionBudgets, affinity/anti-affinity defaults, and a post-install hook that deploys a runbook generator CronJob when runbooks_as_code=true. 3) Installer automation: installer/ansible and installer/scripts add a drill-runbook-generator that emits a runnable playbook (ansible + terraform hooks) and a redwood-drill CLI to execute simulated AZ blackhole + datastore failover and a restore path. 4) Runbooks-as-code: docs/runbooks/ha-drill.md added with executable steps, expected metrics, rollback steps and compliance notes. Runbooks are stored in repo so upgrades/rollbacks can reference exact playbook commits. 5) Testing: tests/e2e/ha-drill-test.tf and a GitHub Actions workflow that runs an e2e failure drill in a test VPC (mock mode) were added so drills are part of CI on release branches. Checklist: - [x] Terraform module for failover wiring - [x] Helm chart updates and default HA values - [x] Installer integration and scripts for drill orchestration - [x] Runbooks-as-code doc and examples - [x] e2e tests and CI workflow - [x] Telemetry hooks for failover events (Prometheus metrics + traces) Backwards compatibility: changes are opt-in by default (helm values runbooks_as_code: false, terraform module not wired into existing default stacks). Security: IAM roles for automated drill runbooks are minimum-privilege and documented. Rollout plan: land on main behind feature flag; notify customers with Private installs and schedule canary drills with on-call. See release_notes for operator-facing summary.

Installer: 'redwood-drill' CLI to simulate AZ failures and run restore playbooks
